label: batch-33
tail:
Batch 33 is authored: the A page has 11 items and the B page has the hidden-state counterexample. All 12 items have current `ready` records with their direct dependencies.

I tightened the Langevin postulate’s initial-position definition and the finite-chain proofs for holding times, the two-sided stationary law, and joint measurability. The proof contracts match the final arguments.

**Scoped checks passed:** strict proof contracts (10/10), precheck (8/8), proof layout (4 changed items, 13 steps), render check (14 files), provenance policy (12/12), selected physics check (12 items), and dependency levels (16-item closure, no mismatches or cycles). Source fetch verification passed (3/3). The [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-33.notes.md>) record the source reading, plan discrepancy, dependencies, and checks.

**Run-wide items for the owner:** the shared dependency-level snapshot has a stale input hash, though batch 33 still computes at level 2 with suppliers 30, 31, and 32. Proof-contract coverage stops at the unrelated empty `emg-mm03` inventory; the scoped contract check passes. Coverage reports one advisory warning about harvest dispositions, documented in the notes. Independent review of draft suppliers and authored items remains pending.

The Aldous–Fill PDF viewer timed out; I searched for and inspected the same book’s official chapter pages, retaining the existing full-text fetch stamp. The [coverage record](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-33.coverage.json>) maps sources to items and dispositions. The inspected treatments include [Aldous–Fill](https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/users/aldous/RWG/Book_Ralph/Ch2.S1.html), [Pavliotis](https://www.ma.imperial.ac.uk/~pavl/PavliotisBook.pdf), and [Seifert](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1205.4176).
